default.label: Track
default.title: Live pace, splits and heart rate on one screen
default.text: Big numbers you can read mid-stride, and a gentle buzz when you drift outside today’s target pace.

screenshot.alt: Pace tracking a run at 5:12 per kilometre with splits below

default.label: Plan
default.title: A training week that moves when you do
default.text: Miss Tuesday’s intervals and Pace reshuffles the rest of the week, so your long run still lands on Sunday.

screenshot.alt: Pace weekly plan with an easy run, intervals and a long run

default.label: Share
default.title: Your club sees the run, not your whole life
default.text: Share a route card with your club or a friend. Start and finish points near home stay hidden by default.

screenshot.alt: Pace route card ready to share with a running club
